history.summary: PROVISIONAL IDENTITY - the CSV name 'Bilaspur Devi Temple' (Yamunanagar) is generic and no shrine by that exact name has a web footprint. It is mapped here to the Shri Mata Mantra Devi Mandir, the best-documented Devi shrine of Bilaspur tehsil, with the ambiguity clearly flagged. Mantra Devi Mandir is a cave shrine dedicated to Goddess Lakshmi near Kathgarh village, reached by road from Jagadhri via Bilaspur, Ranjeetpur and Kathgarh (~35 km motorable, then a ~4 km walk). Tradition holds the Goddess first appeared here as a Beri tree and is now worshipped as a pindi; the cave shrine also holds murtis of Naranarayana, Hanuman and Bharawas, and nearby Gurushikhar hill has murtis of Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma. It is visited together with Kapal Mochan Tirth (sister row 349) and the Adi Badri complex (sister row 351), ~3-4 km away; INTACH lists Mantra Devi Mandir as part of the Adi Badri Temple Complex built heritage - nearby but a distinct shrine, not a duplicate. Founding date and hours are undocumented; Navratri as main festival is a reasonable presumption, not sourced. CSV town 'Yamunanagar' corrected to the Kathgarh/Bilaspur area (district HQ Yamunanagar is ~20-35 km away). Coordinates are POI-level from a place-listing source and should be treated as approximate.

name: Mantra Devi Mandir (Shri Mata Mantra Devi)
town_description: Kathgarh is a village in Bilaspur tehsil of Yamunanagar district, Haryana, in the Shivalik foothills. It lies near the Adi Badri-Kapal Mochan pilgrimage circuit, in an area rich in ancient shrines and Buddhist remains.

travel.railway: Yamunanagar-Jagadhri railway station (~35 km to road-head)
travel.road: Jagadhri to the shrine via Bilaspur-Ranjeetpur-Kathgarh road (~35 km motorable), then ~4 km on foot
